edge_atlas_x: mask bits N=1 E=2 S=4 W=8; set bit if adjoining cell is muddy/outside this material
edge_usage: Underlay muddy source0 (2,variant); overlay source1 (mask,material_row). Same origin and scale. No built-in terrain/autotile metadata; explicit mapping drives placement.
variant_policy: Offset variants preserve light direction. Seamless SAME variant; different phase variants need blended overlays, never butt-join arbitrary phase variants.
